items.synopsis: Traffic flooding when the hardware MAC table not being synchronized with the software MAC table in the ESI environment
items.description: On Junos Evolved QFX5130-32D platform, traffic flooding will be observed due to updates not being performed for the flags in the hardware MAC table resulting in hardware states not being synchronized with software states. This issue is observed when the MAC learned on one ESI (Ethernet Segment Identifier) peer moves to the other peer.

items.synopsis: ARP and ND packets are not getting resolved in vlan-based EVPN service on Junos OS Evolved ACX platforms
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved ACX platforms configured with EVPN-MPLS (Ethernet VPN-Multiprotocol Label Switching) vlan-based EVPN service or EVPN-VXLAN(Ethernet VPN-Virtual Extensible LAN), device is responding to ARP/ND (Address Resolution Protocol/Neighbor Discovery) without any vlan-id tag. Due to this, the ARP/ND response packet will get dropped in LAN network and the local host will not be able to resolve the ARP.

items.synopsis: The inline IPv4 BFD session is flapping on Junos OS Evolved platforms when hierarchical-scheduler is setup
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved platforms, When inline Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) mode is enabled and "hierarchical-scheduler" is configured under the interfaces, the IPv4 bfd sessions will begin to flap, and if any dynamic protocols use the BFD, the protocol will also flap as a result, causing traffic outage.

items.category: Host path software for ACX platform
items.synopsis: Traffic congestion on control plane in Junos Evolved ACX platforms
items.description: On all Junos Evolved ACX platforms, when hierarchical class of service (HCoS), hierarchical quality of service (HQoS) and BFD or BGP are enabled, control plane traffic is affected.

items.synopsis: Traffic loss observed in scenario where default route is received over multiple paths with link protection
items.description: On Junos Evolved ACX7K platforms, the default route received over multiple paths with link protection configured on those paths, does not get programmed properly in the PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) which leads to traffic loss.

items.synopsis: mcsnoopd cored with EVPN-MPLS and VPLS with multicast config
items.description: The mcsnoopd application can crash with quick Snooping Routes(scale numbers) ADD, DEL and ADD with IRB Multicast.

items.category: PRs related to tunnels like GRE, IPIP in EVO control plane
items.synopsis: Traffic loss is observed with FTI over IRB as underlay.
items.description: In case of FTI (Flexible Tunnel Interface) over IRB (Integrated Routing and Bridging) over ethernet, underlay ifl (logical interface) was pointing to IRB instead of ethernet interface leading to packet loss.

items.synopsis: IRB reachability issues may be observed in the EVPN-VXLAN environment when looped ARP comes on ESI-LAG
items.description: On Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms (except MX platforms) with EVPN-VXLAN (Ethernet VPN - Virtual Extensible LAN) configured, in case of traffic loop conditions, self-generated ARP packets (having physical-IRB MAC as SMAC) may come back to the same node where it originated. Such rare scenarios, when the MAC address of the IRB (Integrated Routing and Bridging) ages out and is cleared from the MAC table, also associated MAC-IP route (IRB route) might get cleaned. This may result in IRB reachability issues as the remote VTEPs (Virtual Tunnel End Point) won't have IRB information of the local VTEP and on the local VTEP, there won't be EVPN database entry and type-2 EVPN advertisements for local IRB towards the remote VTEPs.

items.synopsis: CFM DMM with AE may not work with ptx10001-36mr
items.description: CFM DMM with AE may not work with ptx10001-36mr. For ptx10001-36mr, PPMAN does not have "PFE id to PFE instance" mapping and without valid PFE instance value from ppman, packet-io calculates the next available PFE instance to inject CFM DMM PDU and may inject PDU in PFE which does not have CFM session. This will results into CFM PDU drop in DLU with trap dlu ucode discard.

items.synopsis: RPD crashes when multiple ISIS processes are configured
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, RPD crash files are seen during the GRES (graceful restart) event as GRES functionlity is not supported in protocol isis-instance <>.

items.synopsis: LLDP neighborship will not be formed on all Junos devices
items.description: On Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, LLDP (Link Layer Discovery protocol) neighborship will not come up on local device if the local device is using Junos version lower than 22.3 and remote device is using Junos version 21.4R3-S2 and its subsequent service releases or version higher than 22.3.

items.synopsis: RPD process crashes on all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms after adding static route to the VRF in some scenarios
items.description: When static route is added to the VRF (Virtual Routing and Forwarding), and mc-ip (multicast-ip) and the PIM (Protocol Independent Multicast) instance get deleted in some scenarios, the RPD process crash is seen on all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms.

items.category: RPD Next-hop issues including indirect, CNH, and MCNH
items.synopsis: The memory consumption increases due to memory leak
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, a continuous memory leak is observed due to an allocated socket memory not being freed. This is a minor leak but can lead to significant memory usage on highly scaled setups leading to performance and functional impact including system crash beyond a certain point.

items.category: Bug and Review Tracking for Segment routing traffic eng
items.synopsis: The traffic blackhole will be observed when the SRTE shortcut is configured
items.description: On Junos platforms, when the MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching) packet reaches the destination router, it will have a label that is unknown to the destination router due to a label POP operation miss at the ingress router resulting in the traffic black hole in the scenario SR-MPLS (Segment Routing With Multiprotocol Label Switching) + traffic engineering shortcut is configured.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: The mgd process will crash due to stack overflow on high scale address configuration
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms with high scaled addresses (360000 global address-book and above) configured over device, mgd (Management Daemon) crash is seen due to stack overflow when whole global address-book configuration is deleted and also while finding the entries of global address-book for a possible completion of CLI command.

items.synopsis: Crash file is generated when local certificate keychain is missed repeatedly
items.description: On all Junos platforms (M/MX series, ACX series, PTX series, SRX series, T series MX-VC) where kmd is set as control plane daemon which is responsible for IPSec (Internet Protocol Security)related operations, a core file is generated due to continuous failures for a certificate request.

items.synopsis: The dcpfe process will crash due to memory fragmentation
items.description: On Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, the dcpfe (Dense Concentrator Packet Forwarding Engine) process crash will be observed due to memory fragmentation issue. This is a very rare case and would impact traffic as due to dcpfe failure the PFE restarts, so the interfaces will flap.

items.synopsis: rpd core at #2 0x00007f9b2512742c in __assert_fail_base (fmt=0x7f9b2528bae8 "%s%s%s:%u: %s%sAssertion `%s' failed.\n%n", assertion=0x55be37507a48 "nh_idx_t_getval(nhid) == nh_idx_t_getval( rt_nexthops_nhid(rtnh))", file=0x55be375077e8 "../../../../../../../../src/l ayer3/usr.sbin/rpd/lib/krt/ common/krt_ack.c", line=1306, function=) at assert.c:92
items.description: RPD core is sometimes seen if there are many unilist nexthop with identical key values but different metric in Evo, esp when ACK is requested for those nexthops

items.synopsis: Inconsistent RPD core found in rt_walk, task_job_run_job_bg, task_scheduler
items.description: rpd may generate core when running slow related gribi toby scripts in fusion system. Running same scripts in manually deployed testbed will not trigger rpd core.

items.synopsis: Application failure would occur on Routing Engine switchover
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms, application failure would be observed if it exits without cleaning up the zookeeper contents. This is a rare issue, however can have potential impact depending on the application which fails.

items.synopsis: Load replace via XML NetConf will not work
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, the load replace operation through XML NetConf will fail.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: The 'load replace' operation might result in mustd and mgd crash
items.description: On Junos and Junos Evolved platforms with 'apply-group' configured, the mustd and mgd processes might crash when the 'load replace' operation is performed. When this happens, 'apply-groups' will get deleted internally and the respective hierarchies will not be notified.
